pages.text: A snowy hill stood at the alley's end. The three had one wooden sled.
Gugu wanted plenty of rides. "Me first!"
Gugu zoomed downhill on the sled. Wind cooled their face.
Nono offered a hand. "Now give it to me." "No. I want to keep riding."
Gugu pulled the sled uphill alone. It kept tugging backward.
Halfway up, the rope slipped away. The sled slid right back down.
Gugu panted at the bottom. Not one more ride was possible.
Passing, Grandpa Badger said, "One rider down, many helpers up."
Gugu called Nono and Kiki. All three held the rope and pulled the sled smoothly up.
They took turns riding, then pulled it up together again. Gugu got the most rides today.
